|game4= arma3

|gr1= Markers

|eff= global

|descr= Sets the marker alpha. This is a modifier to the existing [[markerColor]] and will be applied on top of the marker color alpha. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.
<br>
When alpha equals {{hl|1}}, the marker is visible, but if alpha equals {{hl|0}}, then the marker is invisible.
<br>
Alpha can be numbers and fractions.
{{Feature|informative|
'''Multiplayer optimisation:''' Global marker commands always broadcast the ''entire'' marker state over the network.
As such, the number of network messages exchanged when creating or editing a marker can be reduced by performing all but the last operation using local marker commands, then using a global marker command for the last change (and subsequent global broadcast of all changes applied to the marker).
}}

|s1= marker [[setMarkerAlpha]] alpha

|p1= marker: [[String]]
|p2= alpha: [[Number]]
|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>"my_marker" setMarkerAlpha 0.5;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>"enemy_convoy_marker" setMarkerAlpha 0;</sqf>

|seealso= [[setMarkerAlphaLocal]] [[setMarkerBrush]] [[setMarkerColor]] [[setMarkerDir]] [[setMarkerPos]] [[setMarkerShape]] [[setMarkerSize]] [[setMarkerText]] [[setMarkerType]] [[createMarker]]
